title: Design System: Casino El Al3ab — Stage & Paper

display.purpose: Chunky game-show headlines; gold gradient + maroon sticker stroke on Stage, maroon ink + gold highlight on Paper.

headline.purpose: Section headings and modal titles with bilingual LTR/RTL tracking rules.

title.purpose: Card titles and player panel names.

score.purpose: Tabular score counters, timers, and casino chip numbers.

body.purpose: Readable bilingual UI copy and admin tables (16px minimum on inputs).

label.purpose: Uppercase badges, eyebrows, and form field labels (no letter-spacing in RTL).

shadows.name: sticker
shadows.purpose: Standard die-cut sticker offset shadow (x mirrors to -4px in RTL).

shadows.name: sticker-sm
shadows.purpose: Compact sticker shadow for badges, chips, and icon pills.

shadows.name: sticker-lg
shadows.purpose: Hero cards, bracket boss node, and dialogs.

shadows.name: soft
shadows.purpose: Calm elevation for Paper admin cards and data tables.

shadows.name: glow-gold
shadows.purpose: Active Buzzed-First highlight and Golden Seat spotlight.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Framer Motion easeOut (200-600ms) for reveals, counters, and tactile press states.

motion.name: sunburst-spin
motion.purpose: Slow Stage sunburst ray rotation (disabled under prefers-reduced-motion).

components.name: Stage Primary Button (Gold)
components.description: Gold gradient sticker CTA used on red Stage and Stage-Dark surfaces.
components.css: .ds-btn-gold { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 14px; border: 2.5px solid var(--red-900, #4F0716); background: linear-gradient(180deg, #FFE066 0%, #FFC12B 40%, #FF9F1C 75%, #E8740C 100%); color: var(--red-900, #4F0716); font-weight: 800; font-size: 14px; box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 var(--red-900, #4F0716); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 150ms ease-out, box-shadow 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-gold:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 6px 6px 0 var(--red-900, #4F0716); } .ds-btn-gold:active { transform: translate(3px, 3px); box-shadow: none; } .ds-btn-gold:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--blue-500, #2F6BFF); outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #FFFFFF; }

components.name: Paper Primary Button (Crimson Red)
components.description: Brand red primary CTA used on white and warm Paper surfaces.
components.css: .ds-btn-red { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 14px; border: 2.5px solid var(--red-900, #4F0716); background: var(--red-600, #C4163A); color: #FFFFFF; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 var(--red-900, #4F0716); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 150ms ease-out, box-shadow 150ms ease-out, background-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-red:hover { background: var(--red-700, #A81233); transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 6px 6px 0 var(--red-900, #4F0716); } .ds-btn-red:active { transform: translate(3px, 3px); box-shadow: none; } .ds-btn-red:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--blue-500, #2F6BFF); outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #FFFFFF; }

components.name: Info Spark Button (White-Buffered Blue)
components.description: Electric blue info/link button with crisp white halo so blue never touches red directly.
components.css: .ds-btn-info { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 14px; border: 2.5px solid #FFFFFF; background: var(--blue-600, #1F4FD8); color: #FFFFFF; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--red-900, #4F0716), 4px 4px 0 var(--red-900, #4F0716); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 150ms ease-out, background-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-info:hover { background: var(--blue-800, #14327F); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-info:active { transform: translate(3px, 3px); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--red-900, #4F0716); } .ds-btn-info:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--blue-500, #2F6BFF); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Sticker Card
components.description: Die-cut white sticker card with 2.5px maroon border and hard offset shadow.
components.html:
Table B · Semi-Final

Live 3-player session with animated score chips.
components.css: .ds-card-sticker { background: #FFFFFF; color: var(--ink, #2A0A10); border: 2.5px solid var(--red-900, #4F0716); border-radius: 20px; padding: 20px; box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 var(--red-900, #4F0716); } .ds-card-sticker p { margin: 8px 0 0; color: var(--ink-muted, #6B4A50); font-size: 14px; }

components.name: Calm Paper Card
components.description: Low-noise Paper card used across Admin tables, forms, and long reading views.
components.html:
Tournament Settings

1px warm border and soft maroon ambient shadow.

components.name: Paper Form Input
components.description: Crisp white input field (>= 16px font, 44px height) turning electric blue on focus.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 12px; border: 2px solid rgba(79, 7, 22, 0.14); background: #FFFFFF; color: var(--ink, #2A0A10); font-size: 16px; transition: border-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: rgba(79, 7, 22, 0.35); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--blue-500, #2F6BFF); outline-offset: 2px; border-color: var(--blue-500, #2F6BFF); }

components.name: Casino Score Chip
components.description: Circular dashed-ring casino chip badge for rank markers and +/- point deltas.
components.css: .ds-chip-gold { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 48px; height: 48px; padding: 5px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 2.5px solid var(--red-900, #4F0716); background: var(--gold-400, #FFC12B); color: var(--red-900, #4F0716); box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 var(--red-900, #4F0716); font-weight: 900; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-chip-inner { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 100%; height: 100%; border-radius: 9999px; border: 2px dashed rgba(79, 7, 22, 0.75); background: var(--gold-200, #FFE899); }

narrative.northStar: The Sunburst Game-Show Stage & Paper Studio
narrative.overview: Bold crimson sunburst Stage sections carry live drama, glossy gold-to-orange sticker lettering, and game-show energy, alternating cleanly with warm off-white Paper sections designed for legible reading, forms, and calm Admin operations.
keyCharacteristics: Red is the stage, white is the page: alternate Stage and Paper bands with angled/zigzag dividers.
Gold is the star: gold-to-orange gradients with thick maroon outlines mark headlines, primary stage CTAs, and winners.
Blue is the spark: electric blue marks focus rings, selection, and upcoming/info chips—always white-buffered when on red.
Sticker energy on Stage, calm clarity in Paper, high-contrast speed on Stage-Dark Scorer Console.
Bilingual EN (LTR) and AR (RTL) as equals, with mirrored sticker shadows and zero Arabic letter-spacing.

rules.name: The Stage vs Paper Rule
rules.body: White text on --red-600 works at any size; gold text on red is reserved for large 24px+ display type; body copy on gold uses --red-900.

rules.name: The White-Buffered Blue Rule
rules.body: Never place electric blue directly against red; sit blue on Paper or inside a white-bordered chip or focus ring.

rules.name: The Sign & Icon Rule
rules.body: Positive and negative points never rely on color alone: always pair color with explicit + / - signs and icons.

rules.name: The No-Faux-Bold & RTL Tracking Rule
rules.body: Disable synthetic font bolding on display faces and keep Arabic letter-spacing at 0.

dos: Do use CSS variables and Tailwind design tokens rather than ad-hoc hex values.
Do use logical properties (ms-, me-, ps-, pe-, text-start) and mirror sticker shadows in RTL.
Do enforce 44px+ minimum touch targets (56px+ on Scorer Console) and 16px+ form inputs.
donts: Don't use photos of real people, copied show logos/artwork, or real-money gambling imagery.
Don't use purple-to-blue gradients, default Tailwind blue, or unthemed shadcn defaults.
Don't place blue elements directly on red backgrounds or use emojis as UI icons.
